name: rankparse
title: RankParse
description: Look up backlinks, domain authority, tech stack, and SEO/site audits from the RankParse API without leaving Raycast.
author: abhi_bavishi

commands.name: search-backlinks
commands.title: Search Backlinks
commands.subtitle: RankParse
commands.description: Browse backlinks, referring domains, outbound links, anchor text, and top pages for a domain.

commands.name: domain-snapshot
commands.title: Domain Snapshot
commands.subtitle: RankParse
commands.description: See domain authority, domain rank, and crawl history for a domain at a glance.

commands.name: cross-domain-compare
commands.title: Cross-Domain Compare
commands.subtitle: RankParse
commands.description: Find domain overlap, link intersect, competitor gaps, and similar domains.

commands.name: page-site-audit
commands.title: Page & Site Audit
commands.subtitle: RankParse
commands.description: Audit page SEO, performance, tech stack, site health, and sitemap for a URL or domain.

commands.name: account
commands.title: RankParse Account
commands.subtitle: RankParse
commands.description: Shows your remaining RankParse credit balance in the menu bar.

commands.name: batch-backlinks
commands.title: Batch Backlinks Lookup
commands.subtitle: RankParse
commands.description: Look up backlinks for up to 50 domains at once.

tools.name: get-backlinks
tools.title: Get Backlinks
tools.description: Get backlinks pointing to a domain, with source domain, anchor text, and link type.

tools.name: get-domain-authority
tools.title: Get Domain Authority
tools.description: Get the domain authority score and referring domain count for a domain.

tools.name: get-tech-stack
tools.title: Get Tech Stack
tools.description: Detect the technology stack (CMS, framework, analytics, hosting, etc.) used by a domain.

preferences.name: apiKey
preferences.title: RankParse API Key
preferences.description: Your RankParse API key (starts with rp_). Get a free one at rankparse.com/dashboard.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
